```         
{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

metrics1 <- read.csv("neuralbandit3_original_metrics_plain.csv")

ggplot(metrics1, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward Normal",
    x = "Training Steps",
    y = "Rolling Reward"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

metrics2 <- read.csv("neuralbandit3_original_metrics_conceptdrift.csv")

metrics2 <- metrics2 %>%
  arrange(step) %>%
  mutate(
    reward_change = rolling_reward - lag(rolling_reward),
    increasing = reward_change > 0,
    recovery_signal = increasing &
      lag(increasing, 1, default = FALSE) &
      lag(increasing, 2, default = FALSE)
  )

metrics2$drift_event <- as.logical(metrics2$drift_event)

drift_points2 <- metrics2 %>%
  filter(drift_event) %>%
  pull(step)

# Make sure drift points are sorted
drift_points2 <- sort(drift_points2)

# Start with an empty data frame
recovery_points2 <- data.frame()

for (i in seq_along(drift_points2)) {
  
  d <- drift_points2[i]
  
  # Stop searching at the next drift
  if (i < length(drift_points2)) {
    next_drift <- drift_points2[i + 1]
  } else {
    next_drift <- Inf
  }
  
  recovery <- metrics2 %>%
    filter(
      step > d,
      step < next_drift,
      drift_event == FALSE,
      recovery_signal == TRUE
    ) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  if (nrow(recovery) > 0) {
    recovery_points2 <- bind_rows(
      recovery_points2,
      data.frame(
        drift_step = d,
        recovery_step = recovery$step,
        rolling_reward = recovery$rolling_reward
      )
    )
  }
}

recovery_points2 <- recovery_points2 %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_time = recovery_step - drift_step
  )

recovery_points2

ggplot(metrics2, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  # Concept drift
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = drift_points2,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  # Recovery begins
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = recovery_points2$recovery_step,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward Concept Drift and Recovery",
    subtitle = "Red = concept drift | Blue = detected recovery",
    x = "Training Steps",
    y = "Rolling Reward"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
